root_cause.text: The vulnerability exists because `ipv6_rpl_srh_rcv()` only expands the `sk_buff` headroom when processing the final segment, failing to account for the potential growth of the recompressed Source Routing Header and the mandatory `mac_len` headroom required by `skb_mac_header_rebuild()`, leading to a MAC header offset wrap-around and out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch updates the `pskb_expand_head()` condition in `net/ipv6/exthdrs.c` from `!hdr->segments_left` to `!hdr->segments_left || skb_headroom(skb) < chdr_len + skb->mac_len`, preventing `skb_push()` from reducing headroom below `mac_len` which caused the `u16 mac_header` field to wrap.

According to the root cause, ipv6_rpl_srh_rcv() has flawed headroom expansion logic that only accounts for the final segment, failing to consider the potential growth of the recompressed Source Routing Header and the mandatory mac_len headroom required by skb_mac_header_rebuild(). This leads to MAC header offset wrap-around and out-of-bounds writes.
